name: Mask of Servitude (Overgrown Tunnel)
backstory: The Mask of Servitude is an Asmodeus tiefling member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She is in the Overgrown Tunnel inside the Riverside Teahouse / Gnarled Teahouse in Act One.
